Team / Maya,

Attached is the day-2 rollup (Q4_Cashline_Rollup_v2.xlsx) with the latest stage-level commitments pulled at 4:50pm PT. Quick summary:

- Pipeline flagged as ready to convert: $1.9M (commit expected next 48 hours)
- At-risk accounts (need PO/MSA): $420k
- Contingent (technical/legal signoff pending): $260k

Actions I need by EOD tomorrow (Nov 28, 5pm PT):
1) Internal owners: confirm the commit percent for accounts you own in the spreadsheet (col: Confirmed%) — mark as 0 / 50 / 100.
2) Finance: Laura, can you confirm whether finance can clear invoicing 24 hours after signed MSA? If yes, mark the PO timing column.
3) Procurement / Maya: if there are any procurement-level blockers, please reply with a one-line ETA.

Notes: we are planning a single consolidated invoice run for closed deals on Tuesday morning. If we get signed MSA + PO before the run, we can include them.

Attachments: Q4_Cashline_Rollup_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet with per-account commit % and PO timing)

Thanks — short and precise please, this will be redistributed to leadership at 5:30pm.

– Aditya Rao

- Regarding retention: our standard is 12 months; we can accept 30 days for an exception but need an exec-approved exception form (I can get sign-off today if necessary).

I uploaded the signed MSA we already have from a previous pilot to the drive link (attached here as signed-MSA-redwood.pdf). For ACME, once you route the updated MSA with the retention variance, please cc finance@redwood.com and I will queue the invoice.

Action items (Laura):
- Queue invoice run for Helix Health today (no PO).
- Prepare exception form for ACME retention variance; will confirm by 2pm PT.

Maya — if you can confirm PO ETA (even a best-effort window) it helps with the Tuesday invoice run cut.
